!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = First-strand cDNA was synthesized using 5 μg of total RNA and the GeneChip One-cycle cDNA Synthesis Kit (Affymetrix, Inc.). Biotin-labeled cRNA was generated by the GeneChip IVT labeling Kit (Affymetrix, Inc.)
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Biotin-labeled cRNA was applied on the Human Genome U133 Plus 2.0 Array (Affymetrix, Inc.) and then hybridized at 45oC for 17 h in a GeneChip Hybridization Oven (Affymetrix, Inc.).
!Sample_scan_protocol = Washing, staining and scanning of the array were performed using the GeneChip Wash and Stain Kit and a GeneChip Scanner 3000 (Affymetrix, Inc.), respectively.
!Sample_description = Sampling of RNA was performed at six different time points (0h, 6h, 1d, 2d, 3d, and 5d, respectively) under RA inducible conditions.
!Sample_data_processing = The average signal intensity for all probes was initially tuned to 500 as global scaling and individual signal intensities were evaluated by detection call (present/marginal/absent) using the Affymetrix Micro Array Suite 5.0 (MAS 5.0) software (Affymetrix, Inc.).
